sloka: प्रथमम् मरणम् नार्या भर्तुर् वैगुण्यम् उच्यते ।सुवृत्तः साधु वृत्तायाः सम्वृत्तस् त्वम् मम अग्रतः ।। ६-३२-९।।
transliteration: prathamam maraṇam nāryā bhartur vaiguṇyam ucyate ।suvṛttaḥ sādhu vṛttāyāḥ samvṛttas tvam mama agrataḥ ।। 6-32-9।।

translations.english: "O Rama, you are faithful to your vows, a noble one! It is said that because of a woman's faults, the husband will die. It is not even so as you died in front of a virtuous woman of good conduct."
